test_item:
The sequence ID is initialized to 0 at IGN ON.
(cold boot on Atl-Mi; the sequence ID is set to 0)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. Send the ignition signal on the Atl-Mi bus
Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN)
2. Read /data/vendor/dauth/seqId on the DUT
$ adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/seqId
er:
1. STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN) is sent
2. The adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/seqId output shows the sequence ID 0
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-SAM-0017 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
sibling axis: EE architecture
channel_feasible: 部分/部分
CAN signal per VHAL User Guide R5 section 2.4; STATUS_BH_BCM2 is 0x46C; raw and label verbatim from P363_BH-CAN [07338]_3A_R2.dbc
